verdict.rationale: Rainforest's pricing page says it leads with a buy-rate, interchange-plus model with no revenue split, and that the platform 'totally control[s]' what it bills merchants. Per-merchant Billing Profiles set the fees and rates merchants are billed, which delivers the buy-rate/sell-rate core of the story. missing for 10: published buy-rate figures in the evidence, explicit documentation of interchange-level cost reporting or visibility for managing the spread, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor pages.
